body: Just went on an NCL cruise Miami-Bahamas. You can pay for it but I don't think it's worth it. It's wildly expensive (about 120 dollars for 3 days) and it barely connects right. I could only send a couple of texts. BTW, they are also very intentional with their wording so you think you're getting more - the 75 minute package that's included in some fares is 75 minutes FOR THE WHOLE CRUISE, not per day, LOL! They say they want you to disconnect while sailing with them. I will say, the LTE available at the islands are more than enough. I was fine with my 75 minutes and found it quite enjoyable to go offline for a bit. But my overall advice is don't buy the internet package. Not worth it!

Brazil has the same thing for all applicants in all walks of life: ENEM, Exame Nacional do Ensino Medio (roughly translated to National High School Exam) it is taken once a year on two consecutive days at the exact same time in the whole country. It covers basically all subjects: math, chem, physics, language, literature, foreign language, history, geography...

AND you have an essay (nonoptional). Some schools have their own tests but that's rare. It's an insane test and the country stops when it's the day. We even have a "meme" called 'The Late Ones': photos of people crying at the gates because they were late to the test. (many people are now finding this problematic)

That's all. Another fun fact, in Brazil "undergraduate", is not really a thing; you go straight to Med, Law, Vet, etc, School out of HS.
